ModMetaData.name: Ancient & Medieval Japan - Scenarios（中世日本 - シナリオ）
ModMetaData.author: sucRo0629
ModMetaData.description: Development candidate for independent starting scenarios. Vanilla base; optional AMJ Grains and Medieval Overhaul integration. With Grains, use the guarded migration version (3b92e3816d78f8ee9596c87a76e937f276d3344c or later); older Core/Grains still provides duplicate DefNames. Explicit XML provider checks pass, but actual game starts and existing-save addition, removal and provider replacement remain unverified. Not release-ready. RawRice 300 is a draft starting-stock choice.
